title: Seeding and Implantation of a Biosynthetic Tissue-engineered Tracheal Graft in a Mouse Model
protocol: Prepare a polymer nanofiber precursor solution by dissolving 8 wt% PET in 1,1,1,3,3,3-hexafluoroisopropanol and heating to 60 °C.
Dissolve 3 wt% PU in 1,1,1,3,3,3-hexafluoroisopropanol at room temperature.
Combine the PET and PU solutions once cooled to create a final polymer mixture of 20:80 ratio.

Electrospin the PET+PU solution onto a stainless steel rod using a high-voltage DC power supply set to +14 kV on the needle, another set to -3 kV, with a flow rate of 5 mL/h and a tip-to-substrate distance of 20 cm.
Rotate the rod at 350 rpm during fiber deposition until the scaffold wall thickness reaches 300 µm.
Slide the scaffold off the rod after electrospinning is complete.
Hold the scaffold under vacuum overnight to remove residual solvent.
Sterilize the scaffold using an ultraviolet light dosage of 350 mJ/cm² prior to implantation.
Euthanize a 6-8 weeks old, female, C57BL/6 mouse with a cocktail of ketamine (200 mg/kg), xylazine (20 mg/kg) and ketoprofen (10 mg/kg).
Check for complete euthanasia by tail-pinch method.
Remove the skin over the femurs and tibias to expose bone using fine scissors and micro-Adson forceps.
Use Dumont #5 forceps and Dumont #5/45 forceps to remove the fascia and the tendons.
Separate the bones and cut each of them on both ends.
Flush the bone marrow in a Petri dish containing 30 mL of Rosewell Park Memorial Institute (RPMI) media using a 5 mL syringe and a 25G needle.
Filter this RPMI with bone marrow through a 70 μm nylon cell strainer into a 50 mL tube.
Place 5 mL of polysurcrose and sodium diatrizoate in a 15 mL tube.
Gently add the RPMI containing bone marrow mononuclear cells down the side of the tube to avoid mixing of the two layers.
Centrifuge at 461 x g for 30 min with "Brake 1" at 24 °C.
Discard the top (pink) layer of plasma.
Collect the middle (clear) layer consisting of the bone marrow mononuclear cells.
Discard the precipitate of red blood cells.
Dilute the bone marrow mononuclear cells (BM-MNC) in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) in a 1:1 ratio.
Centrifuge at 461 x g for 10 min with "Brake 9" at 24 °C.
Remove the supernatant from the pellet.
Dilute the pellet with 5 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge the sample at 461 x g for 10 min with "Brake 9" at 24 °C.
Remove the supernatant and dilute the pellet with ~10 mL of RPMI.
Dilute 10 µL of the BM-MNC solution with an equal volume of 0.4% trypan blue in a 1 mL tube.
Place 10 µL of the diluted solution in a cell counting chamber slide.
Count the cells using an automated cell counter.
Repeat the step and calculate the average number of cells.
Centrifuge the BM-MNC solution at 461 x g for 10 min with "Brake 9" at 24 °C.
Remove the supernatant and dilute the cell concentration to 107 cells/graft.
Measure the lengths of the scaffolds.
If needed, cut the scaffolds to a length of 5 mm.
Pre-wet the scaffold with 5 µL of RPMI for 5 min.
Remove the RPMI.
Add 5 µL of the BM-MNC solution to the lumen of the scaffold for 10 min.
Pass a 21G needle through the lumen of the graft.
Incubate the graft in 1000 µL of RPMI overnight at 37 °C in an incubator.
Use 6-8-week-old female C57BL/6 mice as recipients for cell seeded grafts.
Inject enrofloxacin subcutaneously at a dose of 10 mg/kg, 24 hours before surgery and immediately before incision.
Weigh the mouse and administer an anesthetic cocktail consisting of ketamine (100 mg/kg), xylazine (10 mg/kg) and ketoprofen (5 mg/kg) intraperitoneally at a dose of 0.1 mL/10 g.
Check if the level of anesthesia is achieved using the tail-pinch method.
Apply a sterile ophthalmic ointment to the eyes of the mouse.
Clip the hair on the surgical site from chin to clavicles.
Place the animal in a dorsal recumbent position on a pad under a dissecting microscope with its head away from the surgeon.
Disinfect the surgical site using povidone-iodine, 70% alcohol, and povidone-iodine again.
Make a midline incision ranging from the clavicles to the hyoid bone with fine scissors and micro-Adson forceps.
Clean the fascia with Dumont #5 and Dumont #7 fine forceps, using a sterile cotton swab if needed.
Insert a self-retaining Colibri retractor.
Open strap muscles with Dumont #5 and Dumont #7 fine forceps to expose the thyroid cartilage, cricoid cartilage, and trachea.
Bluntly separate the trachea from recurrent laryngeal nerves running parallel on either side.
Circumferentially separate the trachea from the esophagus.
Stain the anterior portion of the trachea with a 20G needle and surgical marker.
Identify the trachea and make an incision below the third tracheal cartilage ring.
Transect the trachea using Vannas-Tubingen spring scissors and Dumont #7 fine forceps.
Secure the distal trachea to the sternum with sterile 9-0 nylon suture to create a temporary tracheostomy.
Stain the graft to represent the anterior portion using a 20G needle and surgical marker.
Implant the graft by inserting the proximal-posterior, proximal-lateral, and proximal-anterior sutures in that order using 9-0 sterile nylon suture.
Turn the animal 180° to place its tail away from the surgeon.
Release the temporary tracheostomy.
Complete the distal anastomosis by placing the sutures similarly to the proximal anastomosis.
Re-approximate the graft position and strap muscles.
Close the incision using 9-0 sterile nylon sutures in a running pattern.
Inject 0.1 mL of buprenorphine (0.1 mg/kg) subcutaneously.
Place the mouse in a recovery cage on a heating pad.
Observe until conscious and able to ambulate.
Transfer the mouse to a new cage with soft bedding, moist chow, and medicated water (ibuprofen, 30 mg/kg).
Monitor for 48 hours.
Return the mouse to a normal cage with other mice after monitoring period.
Deparaffinize slides using xylene for 5 min.
Repeat deparaffinization step with xylene for another 5 min.
Submerge slides in 100% ethanol for 5 min.
Submerge slides in 90% ethanol for 5 min.
Submerge slides in 70% ethanol for 5 min.
Wash slides with distilled H2O (dH2O) for 5 min.
Place slides in citrate buffer and submerge in water-filled pressure cooker.
Heat the pressure cooker for 10 min.
Allow slides to cool to room temperature after heating.
Wash slides with 0.1% bovine serum albumin in PBS (BSA-PBS) for 5 min.
Rinse slides with dH2O.
Incubate the slides with 3% normal goat serum in PBS for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash with 0.1% BSA-PBS for 5 min.
Incubate in primary antibody with concentrations for keratin 5 (1:1000), keratin 14 (1:250), and F4/80 (1:100) for 18 h overnight at 4 °C.
Wash with 0.1% BSA-PBS twice for 10 min each wash.
Incubate with appropriate secondary antibody at a concentration of 1:500 for K5/K14 and 1:300 F4/80 for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash with 0.1% BSA-PBS twice for 10 min each wash.
Mount using DAPI containing mounting media and glass cover slips.
Allow to sit for 30 min before imaging.
